mapper.select: select c1.C_Name as tendereeName, c1.C_Abbreviation as tendereeAbbName, c2.C_Name as secAgencyName, c2.C_Abbreviation as secAgencyAbbName, dp.D_Name as secContractingDepartmentName, (select count(*) from Sec_Bidding_Plan_Change bpc left join Sec_Info_Change sc on sc.Bpc_Id=bpc.Bpc_Id where sc.Sec_Id=sec.Sec_Id and sc.Sec_Change_Type='变更' and bpc.State!=3 and bpc.State!=7) as unalterable, sec.* from Sec_Info sec left join SYS_Company c1 on c1.C_ID=sec.Sec_Tenderee left join SYS_Company c2 on c2.C_ID=sec.Sec_Agency left join SYS_Department dp on dp.D_ID=sec.Sec_Contracting_Department where sec.Bp_Id=#{bpId}

select f.file_relation_id as fileRelationId, u1.U_Name as bpTendereeName, c2.C_Name as bpCname, mn.*, u2.U_Name as responsibleLeaderName from Sec_Bidding_Plan mn left join SYS_User u1 on u1.U_Id=mn.Bp_Tenderee left join SYS_Company c2 on c2.C_Id=mn.Bp_Cid left join Sys_File f on f.FileID=mn.Bp_Id left join SYS_User u2 on u2.U_Id=mn.Responsible_Leader where mn.Bp_Id=#{bpId}

select sum(si_agg.secMoneys) as secMoneySum, sum(si_agg.secInfoTotal) as secInfoSum, sum(si_agg.finishCount) as finishSum from Sec_Bidding_Plan mn left join SYS_Company c1 on c1.C_Id=mn.Bp_Tenderee left join ( select sec.Bp_Id, sum(sec.Sec_Money) as secMoneys, count(1) as secInfoTotal, sum( case when sec.Sec_Bidding_Type='05' then (select count(*) from Sec_Price_Resultsf pr where pr.State=7 and pr.Sec_Id=sec.Sec_Id) else case when sec.Sec_Bidding_Type='03' then (select count(*) from Sec_Entrust se where se.State=7 and se.Sec_Id=sec.Sec_Id) else (select count(*) from Sec_Win_Notice wn where wn.Wn_State=7 and wn.Sec_Id=sec.Sec_Id) end end ) as finishCount from Sec_Info sec group by sec.Bp_Id ) si_agg on si_agg.Bp_Id=mn.Bp_Id where 1=1

select * from Sec_Bidding_Plan sbp left join Sec_Bidding_Project sbproject on sbp.Bp_Id=sbproject.Bp_Id left join Pre_Project pp on sbproject.P_Id=pp.P_Id
and pp.P_Id in
#{projectId}
and sbp.is_new = '1'
and (sbp.is_new is null or sbp.is_new = '')
select sbp.* from Sec_Bidding_Plan sbp left join Sec_Bidding_Project sbproject on sbp.Bp_Id=sbproject.Bp_Id where sbp.state!=3 and sbproject.p_id = #{pId}

select f.file_relation_id as fileRelationId, u1.U_Name as bpTendereeName, c2.C_Name as bpCname, mn.*, u2.U_Name as responsibleLeaderName from Sec_Bidding_Plan mn left join Sec_Bidding_Project sbproject on mn.Bp_Id=sbproject.Bp_Id left join SYS_User u1 on u1.U_Id=mn.Bp_Tenderee left join SYS_Company c2 on c2.C_Id=mn.Bp_Cid left join Sys_File f on f.FileID=mn.Bp_Id left join SYS_User u2 on u2.U_Id=mn.Responsible_Leader where sbproject.p_id = #{pId} order by mn.Bp_Create_Time desc limit 1
